title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance: a store-rule check for the coding agent
friendlyTitle: App Store Compliance is a rule check for a coding helper.
summary: App Store Compliance gained 542 stars on GitHub's daily trending list. The repo has 1,725 stars. It is a playbook and pre-submission guard for App Store and Google Play rules, with a skill for coding agents. Version 2.4.0 was tagged on 15 November. The license is OpenRoots Agent License 2.3, not a standard open-source license.
friendlySummary: This project gained 542 stars on GitHub's daily trending list. The repo has 1,725 stars. whyItMatters: Point a coding agent at it before you submit an app, then read the findings yourself. The project says it tracks 117 rejection patterns. That count is the author's. A passing check is not store approval.
